translations.web: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
translations.bsb: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
translations.kjv: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
translations.asv: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.
